Market today: Mixed signals. There's talk of a "face-ripper rally," but persistent oil price pressure, high debt costs, and upcoming inflation data create significant uncertainty. This environment is tough for your tech/chip names, especially on margin.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.51%) and SPAL (-33.52%) are major concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs with huge losses, and their listed stops are ineffective given current prices. SMH (-11.96%) and QQQ (-0.84%) also have TRIM signals and losses. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the upcoming consumer inflation data and how oil prices evolve. These will heavily influence Treasury yields and the broader market sentiment for growth stocks.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged positions and be ready to adjust to inflation data.
plays: SOXL: Your stop at 200 is far above the current price of 115.76, with a -54.51% loss. Re-evaluate this stop immediately to manage risk on this leveraged position.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, your stop at 21.38 is above the current price of 16.72, with a -33.52% loss. Tighten this stop to protect capital on this volatile ETF.
SPY: Scanner says SELL, but you're up 3.19%. Consider trimming some profit or tightening your stop at 705 to lock in gains.
